fields.instructions: 力をつけ活躍する先輩たち Swiper carousel. Editors may add, remove, and reorder slides. PC and SP quote copy are kept as two separate fields because the current markup genuinely renders two distinct, manually-authored line-break variants (not an invented split). Slide count / current-index label / progress bar all derive from this repeater at render time.
